claim_ceiling: VERIFIED AT 1.2K SCALE ONLY: center_projected REPRODUCED on 384-dim MiniLM-L12-v2 passes BOTH adversarial gates (LangDom=0.5310, JP=0.9817) on 1,200 decisions (2020-2024). cited_decisions_tfidf validated as first unsupervised signal passing both gates (LangDom=0.5964, JP=0.6158, NMI=0.565) but FAILS 4/11 standalone benchmarks (cross-lingual transfer, language quality, boilerplate resistance, Jurivoc alignment). hybrid_cited_0.3 best tradeoff (JP=0.9550, ImpRate=48.3%, HAdv=0.095). v5 hybrids superseded (all FAIL JP). Metric learning (linear JP=0.6847, Mahalanobis JP=0.6781) passes at 1.2k. FUNDAMENTAL GAP: v29 shows center_projected CATASTROPHICALLY FAILS at 130k (JP=0.0475); 1.2k recent-corpus PASS does not generalize. Jurivoc hierarchy alignment FAILS for all representations. No holdout validation for dense representations.
evidence_summary: Independently verified 7 primary evidence files: (1) comprehensive_validation_all_results.json — 5 representations, all pass adversarial gates, fractal metrics computed; (2) standalone_all_results.json — 11-benchmark suite: center_projected/hybrid_cited_0.3 pass 9/11 (fail jurivoc, skip zoom), cited_decisions_tfidf passes 6/11 (fails cross-lingual transfer, language quality, boilerplate, jurivoc); (3) adversarial_signal_validation_results.json — all 24 v5 hybrids FAIL jurist gate (JP 0.00-0.46), confirming supersession; (4) metric_learning_results.json — linear/mahalanobis projections pass adversarial gates at epochs 4-20 (JP 0.66-0.68); (5) reproduce_center_projected_v2.py — MiniLM-L12-v2 384-dim reproduction confirmed; (6) v6_comprehensive_validation.py — main validation script; (7) v29 state file — BLOCKED_ON_DEPENDENCIES at 174k scale with catastrophic dense failure (JP=0.0475 at 130k). Scale discrepancy documented: 1.2k recent decisions vs 174k target. All negative results (benchmark failures, overclustering, cross-lingual gaps, Jurivoc FAIL) present in evidence but under-emphasized in report narrative.
